Fa-wa-Allāh turbu qadamihi la-yakūnu aʿlā ʿan kull mā khuliqa wa-yukhlaqu wa-ʿan kull mā kāna wa-mā yakūn wa-in ʿaraftu bi-anna al-nufūs lan yaḍṭariba la-qultu innahu ʿarsh Allāh fī al-arḍ li-anna ʿalayhi yaqaʿu rijluhu al-ʿazīz al-maḥbūb wa-innaka fa-thbut fī-mā alqaynāka bi-ḥaythu lan yazilla qadamāka wa-lā takūnanna min alladhīna hum lā yaʿrifūna wa-yansibūna hādhā al-maqām ilā alladhīna hum yurīdūn fa-wa-Allāh hādhā khaṭaʾ lam yakun fī al-imkān ka-shibhihi ittaqū Allāh yā qawm wa-lā tatajāwazū ʿammā ḥuddida fī kitāb Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm

By God, the dust beneath His feet is more exalted than all that has been or will be created, and than all that has been and will be. Were I assured that souls would not be thrown into turmoil, I would say that it is the throne of God on earth, for upon it rests His mighty and beloved foot. Remain so steadfast in what We have imparted to you that your feet will never slip. Do not be among those who do not understand and ascribe this station to whomever they wish. By God, this is an error without parallel in the world of being. Fear God, O people, and do not transgress the bounds set in the Book of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.

86

فسبحانک اللّهمّ یا الهی انت الّذی الهمتنی بدایع ذکرک ثمّ منعتنی عن اظهارها بین بریّتک و اخذتنی علی مقام الّذی صرت ممنوعاً عن اظهار جوامع اسرار حکمتک بما ظهرت آثار الغفلة فی خلقک لأنّی یا الهی ان اکتم عن النّاس ما اعطیتنی بجودک لأکون فی تلک الحالة کافراً بنعمتک و ان احدث لهم ما اکرمتنی بفضلک اذاً یرفع ضجیج ارقّائک و صریخ عبادک و لم ار کلّ ذلک الّا منک لأنّک بعثتنی و اظهرتنی فی ایّام الّتی ما بعثت فی مثلها احد من صفوتک و لم ادر بذلک ما اردت من ظهورات قضائک و تقدیرک و شئونات امضائک و تدبیرک

Fa-subḥānaka Allāhumma yā ilāhī anta alladhī alhamtanī badāʾiʿa dhikrika thumma manaʿtanī ʿan iẓhārihā bayna bariyyatika wa-akhadhtanī ʿalā maqām alladhī ṣirtu mamnūʿan ʿan iẓhār jawāmiʿ asrār ḥikmatika bi-mā ẓaharat āthār al-ghafla fī khalqika li-annī yā ilāhī in aktum ʿan al-nās mā aʿṭaytanī bi-jūdika la-akūna fī tilka al-ḥāla kāfiran bi-niʿmatika wa-in uḥaddith lahum mā akramtanī bi-faḍlika idhan yurfaʿu ḍajīj ariqqāʾika wa-ṣarīkh ʿibādika wa-lam ara kulla dhālika illā minka li-annaka baʿathtanī wa-aẓhartanī fī ayyām allatī mā baʿathta fī mithlihā aḥad min ṣafwatika wa-lam adri bi-dhālika mā aradta min ẓuhūrāt qaḍāʾika wa-taqdīrika wa-shuʾūnāt imḍāʾika wa-tadbīrika

Glory be to You, O God, my God! You are the One who inspired Me with the wondrous expressions of Your remembrance, then prevented Me from disclosing them among Your creatures. You have brought Me to a station where I am prevented from disclosing the all-embracing mysteries of Your wisdom because the signs of heedlessness have appeared among Your creation. For, O my God, if I conceal from the people what You have bestowed upon Me through Your generosity, I would then be ungrateful for Your favor; and if I tell them of what You have graciously conferred upon Me, the clamor of Your servants and the outcry of Your worshippers will rise. Yet I see all this as coming only from You, for You have raised Me up and made Me manifest in days the like of which You have never chosen for raising up any of Your chosen ones. I do not know what You have intended thereby through the manifestations of Your decree and ordainment, and the workings of Your enactment and ordering.

87

فوعزّتک یا محبوبی اشهد بأنّ علمک ما احاط یوماً اعظم و اشدّ من هذه الأیّام لأنّ فیها یمحّص کلّ العباد من کلّ وضیع و شریف ولکن انّی مع عجزی و فقری و ضرّی و مسکنتی لأکون مستقیماً علی امرک بحولک و قوّتک و لو لن یقبل احد بهذا الوجه طلباً للقائک و اشکرک بما اعطیتنی و اکرمتنی من استقامة الّتی لن یقدر احد ان یردّها عن مقامها ولو یرفع علی رأسی سیوف المنکرین و اعراض المشرکین و اشهد بأنّ ذرّة من هذه الاستقامة لخیر من عبادة الثّقلین و بذلک یستریح قلبی و تسکن نفسی و لن اشاهد کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض الّا ککفّ من الطّین بل احقر من ذلک الّا من دخل فی ظلّک فی هذا الاسم الأتمّ الأعظم الّذی به انقلبت کلّ الأسمآء و تغیّرت کلّ الصّفات فی جبروت البدآء لأنّ الّذینهم لن یعرفوک لم یکن لهم شأن عندک و لا لهم ذکر بین یدیک اذاً اسئلک یا محبوبی بأن لا تزلّ قدمی عن امرک الّذی لن یقوم معه شیء ثمّ ثبّتنی بجودک و فضلک ثمّ انقطعنی عن دونک و انّک انت العزیز القادر العلیم الحکیم القیّوم

Fa-wa-ʿizzatika yā maḥbūbī ashhadu bi-anna ʿilmaka mā aḥāṭa yawman aʿẓama wa-ashadda min hādhihi al-ayyām li-anna fīhā yumaḥḥaṣu kullu al-ʿibād min kulli waḍīʿin wa-sharīf wa-lākin innanī maʿa ʿajzī wa-faqrī wa-ḍurrī wa-maskanatī la-akūnu mustaqīman ʿalā amrika bi-ḥawlika wa-quwwatika wa-law lan yuqbila aḥadun bi-hādhā al-wajh ṭalaban li-liqāʾika wa-ashkuruka bi-mā aʿṭaytanī wa-akramtanī min istiqāmati allatī lan yaqdira aḥadun an yaruddahā ʿan maqāmihā wa-law yurfaʿu ʿalā raʾsī suyūfu al-munkirīn wa-iʿrāḍu al-mushrikīn wa-ashhadu bi-anna dharratan min hādhihi al-istiqāma la-khayrun min ʿibādati al-thaqalayn wa-bi-dhālika yastarīḥu qalbī wa-taskunu nafsī wa-lan ushāhida kulla man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍ illā ka-kaffin min al-ṭīn bal aḥqara min dhālika illā man dakhala fī ẓillika fī hādhā al-ismi al-atammi al-aʿẓam alladhī bihi inqalabat kullu al-asmāʾ wa-taghayyarat kullu al-ṣifāt fī jabarūti al-badāʾ li-anna alladhīna hum lan yaʿrifūka lam yakun lahum shaʾnun ʿindaka wa-lā lahum dhikrun bayna yadayka idhan asʾaluka yā maḥbūbī bi-an lā tazilla qadamī ʿan amrika alladhī lan yaqūma maʿahu shayʾ thumma thabbitnī bi-jūdika wa-faḍlika thumma inqaṭiʿnī ʿan dūnika wa-innaka anta al-ʿAzīz al-Qādir al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm al-Qayyūm.

By Your might, O my Beloved, I testify that Your knowledge has never encompassed a day greater or more severe than these days, for in them all Your servants, both lowly and eminent, are put to the test. Yet despite my helplessness, poverty, affliction, and destitution, I will remain steadfast in Your Cause through Your power and strength, even if no one turns toward this Face seeking to meet You. I thank You for the steadfastness You have bestowed upon me and with which You have honored me, which no one can dislodge from its station, even if the swords of the deniers and the rejection of those who associate partners with You are raised over my head. I testify that a particle of this steadfastness is better than the worship of both humankind and jinn. Through it my heart finds rest and my soul becomes calm, and I regard all who are in the heavens and on earth as no more than a handful of clay—indeed, as less than that—except those who have entered beneath Your shadow in this most perfect, most great Name, through which all names have been transformed and all attributes changed in the dominion of the revision of divine decree. For those who do not recognize You have no standing with You, nor are they mentioned in Your presence. I therefore ask You, O my Beloved, not to let my foot slip from Your Cause, alongside which nothing can stand. Make me steadfast through Your generosity and grace, and detach me from all besides You. You are indeed the Almighty, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, the Self-Subsisting.

88

و انّا کنّا ان نکتب هذه الألواح بالفارسی و امسک اللّه القلم عنه و ارجعه الی لسان عربیّ مبین لذا قد القیناک من اسرار العلم و الحکمة بهذا اللّسان ثمّ نرجع الی لسان الأعجمین لیتمّ علیک حجّة اللّه و برهانه و دللیه و آیاته لعلّ تکوننّ من المقبلین الی اللّه الّذی خلقنی و ایّاکم و نحن له لمن العابدین و الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Wa-innā kunnā an naktuba hādhihi al-alwāḥ bi-al-fārisī wa-amsaka Allāhu al-qalama ʿanhu wa-arjaʿahu ilā lisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīn li-dhā qad alqaynāka min asrāri al-ʿilmi wa-al-ḥikma bi-hādhā al-lisān thumma narjiʿu ilā lisāni al-aʿjamīn li-yatimma ʿalayka ḥujjatu Allāhi wa-burhānuhu wa-[corrupted text] wa-āyātuhu laʿalla takūnanna min al-muqbilīn ilā Allāhi alladhī khalaqanī wa-iyyākum wa-naḥnu lahu la-min al-ʿābidīn wa-al-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

We had intended to write these Tablets in Persian, but God held the Pen back from it and returned it to a clear Arabic tongue. Thus We have imparted to you some of the mysteries of knowledge and wisdom in this tongue. Now We return to the tongue of the Persians, so that God’s testimony, His proof, [corrupted original text], and His signs may be complete for you, that you may be among those who turn toward God, who created Me and you. We are indeed among His worshippers. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

89

و از این بیانات مشرقه از افق تبیان معلوم و مبرهن شده که اطلاق اسم شمس بر هر یک از مظاهر این اسماء مشرقهٴ مذکوره من اولی الحکمة شده و میشود پس اگر در بیانات مظاهر احدیّه و مطالع قدس صمدیّه ذکر شمس ملحوظ و مذکور شود مقصود این شموس مشرقه و انوار منیره خواهند بود الّا من شآء ربّک

Va az īn bayānāt-e moshreqe az ofoq-e tebyān maʿlūm va mobarhan shode ke eṭlāq-e esm-e shams bar har yek az maẓāher-e īn asmā-ye moshreqe-ye madhkūre min ulī al-ḥikma shode va mīshavad pas agar dar bayānāt-e maẓāher-e aḥadīye va maṭāleʿ-e qods-e ṣamadīye dhekr-e shams malḥūẓ va madhkūr shavad maqṣūd īn shomūs-e moshreqe va anvār-e monīre khāhand būd illā man shāʾa rabbuka.

From these utterances shining from the horizon of exposition, it has become clear and demonstrable that those endowed with wisdom have applied, and continue to apply, the name “sun” to each of the manifestations of these radiant names already mentioned. Thus, if mention of the sun is found in the utterances of the Manifestations of divine unity and the Daysprings of eternal holiness, what is intended will be these shining suns and radiant lights, except as your Lord may will.

90

و دیگر آنکه بر صاحبان علم و حکمت و فطرت سلیم و طینت منیر معلوم و مبرهن بوده که در هر عهد و عصریکه کشف سبحات جلال از وجه جمال شد و طلعت مستورهٴ مقنّعهٴ مغطئه از حجب غیب ظاهر و مشهود گشت آن شجرهٴ حقیقت ربّانیّه و ثمرهٴ جنیّهٴ الهیّه را بخود او باید ادراک نمود چه که دون او در ظلّ او بوده و خواهد بود و مقامات مستورهٴ آن کنز احدیّه از بیانات مشرقهٴ او ادراک میشود

Va dīgar ānke bar ṣāḥebān-e ʿelm va ḥekmat va feṭrat-e salīm va ṭīnat-e monīr maʿlūm va mobarhan būde ke dar har ʿahd va ʿaṣrī ke kashf-e soboḥāt-e jalāl az vajh-e jamāl shod va ṭalʿat-e mastūre-ye moqannaʿe-ye moghaṭṭaʾe az ḥojob-e gheyb ẓāher va mashhūd gasht ān shajare-ye ḥaqīqat-e rabbānīye va thamare-ye janīye-ye elāhīye rā be-khod-e ū bāyad edrāk namūd che ke dūn-e ū dar ẓell-e ū būde va khāhad būd va maqāmāt-e mastūre-ye ān kanz-e aḥadīye az bayānāt-e moshreqe-ye ū edrāk mīshavad.

Furthermore, it has been clear and demonstrable to those possessed of knowledge and wisdom, sound dispositions and illumined natures, that in every age and era when the veils of glory are lifted from the face of beauty, and that concealed, veiled, and hidden Countenance emerges visibly from the veils of the unseen, that Tree of divine Reality and ripe Fruit of God must be recognized through Himself. For all besides Him has been, and will remain, beneath His shadow, and the hidden stations of that Treasure of unity are apprehended through His radiant utterances.

91

اگرچه بصر حدید مقدّس از مشاهده فطور و تحدید از جمیع ما یظهر منه آثار عظمة اللّه مشاهده مینماید چه که تجلّیات آن شمس مشرقهٴ محیطه اظهر از آن است که از انظار عارفین مستور ماند و تموّجات آن بحر اعظم ابین از آن است که از ابصار مقرّبین محجوب گردد ولکن چون ناس متفاوتند در معارج علم و ایقان لهذا محض ظهور فضل و جود و بروز فیض و عنایت بر کلّ وجود آیات نازله از سماء مشیّت و بیّنات مشرقه از افق فضل را حجّت خود قرار فرموده‌اند که تا جمیع ناس از اعالی و ادانی از این حجّت لایحهٴ بالغه و آیات مشرقهٴ درّیّه آن ذات قدم و کلمهٴ اتمّ را ادراک نمایند

Agarche baṣar-e ḥadīd-e moqaddas az moshāhede-ye foṭūr va taḥdīd az jamīʿ-e mā yaẓharu minhu āthār-e ʿaẓamat Allāh moshāhede mīnamāyad che ke tajallīyāt-e ān shams-e moshreqe-ye moḥīṭe aẓhar az ān ast ke az anẓār-e ʿārefīn mastūr mānad va tamavvojāt-e ān baḥr-e aʿẓam abyan az ān ast ke az abṣār-e moqarrabīn maḥjūb gardad va-lāken chūn nās motafāvetand dar maʿārej-e ʿelm va īqān le-hādhā maḥḍ-e ẓohūr-e faḍl va jūd va borūz-e feyḍ va ʿenāyat bar koll-e vojūd āyāt-e nāzele az samā-ye mashīyat va bayyenāt-e moshreqe az ofoq-e faḍl rā ḥojjat-e khod qarār farmūde-and ke tā jamīʿ-e nās az aʿālī va adānī az īn ḥojjat-e lāʾeḥe-ye bāleghe va āyāt-e moshreqe-ye dorrīye ān dhāt-e qedam va kaleme-ye atamm rā edrāk namāyand.

A penetrating sight, sanctified from perceiving flaw and limitation, does indeed behold the traces of God’s greatness in all that proceeds from Him. For the splendors of that radiant, all-encompassing Sun are too manifest to remain hidden from the eyes of those who possess true knowledge, and the surging of that Most Great Ocean is too evident to be concealed from the sight of those brought near. Yet because people differ in their degrees of knowledge and certitude, solely to manifest grace and generosity and to extend bounty and favor to all existence, He has appointed the verses sent down from the heaven of His will and the clear evidences shining from the horizon of His grace as His testimony, so that all people, high and low alike, may recognize that eternal Essence and most perfect Word through this manifest and conclusive testimony and these radiant, resplendent verses.

92

کلّ ذلک من فضله علی العباد من دون استحقاقهم بذلک بوده و خواهد بود که شاید از فیوضات ربّانیّه و عنایات قدسیّهٴ الهیّه محروم نمانند والّا اعراض جمیع موجودات و اقبال جمیع ممکنات در آن ساحت اقدس یکسان خواهد بود و دیگر آنکه در یوم ظهور آن نیّر اعظم هیچ عذری از هیچ نفسی مسموع نخواهد بود مثلاً اگر جمیع من فی الأرض از جمیع صحف سماویّه و کتب منزله استدلال نمایند بر امری و آن جوهر وجود بر خلاف آن امر مسلّمهٴ محکمه ظاهر شوند احدیرا نرسد که اعتراض نماید چه که جمیع امر و نهی باراده و قبول او مشروط و منوط است و بیانات ظاهره از آن سمآء احدیّه مشروط و معلّق بامری نبوده و نخواهد بود

Kullu dhālika min faḍlihi ʿalā al-ʿibād min dūni istiḥqāqihim bi-dhālika būde va khāhad būd ke shāyad az foyūḍāt-e rabbānīye va ʿenāyāt-e qodsīye-ye elāhīye maḥrūm namānand va-illā eʿrāḍ-e jamīʿ-e mowjūdāt va eqbāl-e jamīʿ-e momkenāt dar ān sāḥat-e aqdas yeksān khāhad būd va dīgar ānke dar yowm-e ẓohūr-e ān nayyer-e aʿẓam hīch ʿodhrī az hīch nafsī masmūʿ nakhāhad būd mathalan agar jamīʿ-e man fī al-arḍ az jamīʿ-e ṣoḥof-e samāvīye va kotob-e monzale estedlāl namāyand bar amrī va ān jowhar-e vojūd bar khelāf-e ān amr-e mosallame-ye moḥkame ẓāher shavand aḥadī rā narasad ke eʿterāḍ namāyad che ke jamīʿ-e amr va nahy be-erāde va qabūl-e ū mashrūṭ va manūṭ ast va bayānāt-e ẓāhere az ān samā-ye aḥadīye mashrūṭ va moʿallaq be-amrī nabūde va nakhāhad būd.

All this has been, and will remain, a token of His grace to His servants, without their deserving it, so that they may not be deprived of divine outpourings and God’s holy favors. Otherwise, the rejection of all beings and the acceptance of all created things would be alike in that most holy court. Furthermore, on the day of the appearance of that Most Great Luminary, no excuse from anyone will be accepted. For example, if everyone on earth were to draw upon all the heavenly scriptures and revealed books to establish a matter, and that Essence of being were to appear contrary to that firmly established and acknowledged matter, no one would have the right to object. For every command and prohibition is conditional upon and dependent on His will and acceptance, whereas the utterances issuing from that Heaven of unity have never been, and will never be, conditional upon or dependent on anything.

93

ای طالب با سینهٴ منیر باین سینای روح درآی تا تجلّی شمس معانی را در طور دل مشاهده نمائی و اصنام وهم و ظنّ را بقوّهٴ خلیلی بشکنی و از تقلید و تقیید و تحدید خالص و مقدّس شده بمعارج یقین و ثبوت و استقامت عروج نمائی

Ey ṭāleb bā sīne-ye monīr be-īn Sīnā-ye rūḥ darāy tā tajallī-ye shams-e maʿānī rā dar Ṭūr-e del moshāhede namāʾī va aṣnām-e vahm va ẓann rā be-qovve-ye khalīlī beshkanī va az taqlīd va taqyīd va taḥdīd khāleṣ va moqaddas shode be-maʿārej-e yaqīn va thobūt va esteqāmat ʿorūj namāʾī.

O seeker, enter this Sinai of the spirit with an illumined heart, so that you may behold the splendor of the Sun of meanings upon the Sinai of the heart, shatter the idols of fancy and conjecture with the power of Abraham, and, freed and sanctified from imitation, restriction, and limitation, ascend to the heights of certainty, constancy, and steadfastness.

94

و دیگر ملاحظه نما که اگر جمیع من فی البیان بجمیع ما فی البیان استدلال بامری نمایند در شرایط ظهور بعد و مسلّم دارند که آن جمال موعود و شمس وجود باین علامت مذکوره باید ظاهر شود و آن جوهر اختیار بر خلاف آن ظاهر شود حال چه خواهی کرد آیا بآنچه ادراک نموده مستغنی خواهی بود از عرفان آن شمس معارف لا فوالّذی علّم هذا القلم من اسرار القدم هیچ چیز تو را کفایت نمینماید مگر تشبّث بذیل عطوفت او

Va dīgar molāḥeẓe namā ke agar jamīʿ-e man fī al-Bayān be-jamīʿ-e mā fī al-Bayān estedlāl be-amrī namāyand dar sharāyeṭ-e ẓohūr-e baʿd va mosallam dārand ke ān jamāl-e mowʿūd va shams-e vojūd be-īn ʿalāmat-e madhkūre bāyad ẓāher shavad va ān jowhar-e ekhtīyār bar khelāf-e ān ẓāher shavad ḥāl che khāhī kard āyā be-ānche edrāk namūde mostaghnī khāhī būd az ʿerfān-e ān shams-e maʿāref lā fa-wa-alladhī ʿallama hādhā al-qalama min asrāri al-qidam hīch chīz to rā kefāyat nemīnamāyad magar tashabboth be-dheyl-e ʿoṭūfat-e ū.

Consider also: if all the people of the Bayán were to draw upon everything in the Bayán to establish a condition for the next Revelation, and were to take it as certain that the promised Beauty and Sun of existence must appear with this stated sign, but that Essence of free choice were to appear otherwise, what would you do then? Would what you had understood make you independent of recognizing that Sun of knowledge? No, by the One who taught this Pen the mysteries of eternity! Nothing will suffice you except holding fast to the hem of His loving-kindness.

95

آیا ملاحظه نشد که امم سابقه باعتکاف بر اصنام ظنون و هوی چگونه از فضل یوم الفصل محروم مانده‌اند باری در جمیع حال و احوال پناه بحقّ برده که بآنچه در سموات و ارض مشهود بینی چه از بیانات محقّقه و چه از امورات ظاهره از شجرهٴ مقصود و عرفان او که که عین عرفان مظاهر لا اوّلیّه و لا آخریّهٴ الهیّه است باز نمانی جهد کنید تا از غیث هاطلهٴ سحاب مرتفعهٴ الهیّه محجوب نمانید

Āyā molāḥeẓe nashod ke omam-e sābeqe be-eʿtekāf bar aṣnām-e ẓonūn va havā chegūne az faḍl-e yowm al-faṣl maḥrūm mānde-and bārī dar jamīʿ-e ḥāl va aḥvāl panāh be-Ḥaqq borde ke be-ānche dar samāvāt va arḍ mashhūd bīnī che az bayānāt-e moḥaqqaqe va che az omūrāt-e ẓāhere az shajare-ye maqṣūd va ʿerfān-e ū ke ke ʿeyn-e ʿerfān-e maẓāher-e lā-avvalīye va lā-ākherīye-ye elāhīye ast bāz namānī jahd konīd tā az gheyth-e hāṭele-ye saḥāb-e mortafeʿe-ye elāhīye maḥjūb namānīd.

Have you not observed how the peoples of the past, through their devotion to the idols of conjecture and desire, have remained deprived of the grace of the Day of Decision? In every condition and circumstance, take refuge in God, so that nothing you see in the heavens and on earth, whether established utterances or outward events, may keep you from the Tree of desire and from recognizing Him, which—which is itself the recognition of the divine Manifestations who have neither beginning nor end. Strive not to remain veiled from the pouring rain of God’s uplifted clouds.

96

اگرچه سحاب فضل در جمیع اوقات مرتفع است و او را انقطاع پدید نه ولکن هر سحابی مظهر فیض کلّیّه نبوده و نخواهد بود در شمس و صعود و نزول او ملاحظه نما اگرچه او در ذات خود مقدّس از صعود و نزول است ولکن بتغییر منازل و بروج بمقادیر مختلفه ظاهر و مجلّی مثل آنکه در برج اسد بکمال ظهور و حرارت ظاهر است و در دون آن غیر آن مشهود و حال که بفضل اللّه سحاب رحمت جمیع ارض و ساکنین آن را احاطه نموده و شمس عنایت بکمال تجلّی و حرارت ظاهر و لایح است خود را بوساوس شیاطین نفسیّه و هیاکل بغضیّهٴ حسدیّه مشغول ننمائید

Agarche saḥāb-e faḍl dar jamīʿ-e owqāt mortafeʿ ast va ū rā enqeṭāʿ padīd na va-lāken har saḥābī maẓhar-e feyḍ-e kollīye nabūde va nakhāhad būd dar shams va ṣoʿūd va nozūl-e ū molāḥeẓe namā agarche ū dar dhāt-e khod moqaddas az ṣoʿūd va nozūl ast va-lāken be-taghīr-e manāzel va borūj be-maqādīr-e mokhtalefe ẓāher va mojallī methl-e ānke dar borj-e Asad be-kamāl-e ẓohūr va ḥarārat ẓāher ast va dar dūn-e ān gheyr-e ān mashhūd va ḥāl ke be-faḍl Allāh saḥāb-e raḥmat jamīʿ-e arḍ va sākenīn-e ān rā eḥāṭe namūde va shams-e ʿenāyat be-kamāl-e tajallī va ḥarārat ẓāher va lāʾeḥ ast khod rā be-vasāves-e shayāṭīn-e nafsīye va hayākel-e boghḍīye-ye ḥasadīye mashghūl nanamāʾīd.

Although the cloud of grace is raised at all times and never ceases, not every cloud has been, or will be, the manifestation of all-encompassing bounty. Consider the sun and its ascent and descent. Although in its own essence it is sanctified from ascent and descent, with the changing of its stations and zodiacal signs it appears and shines in different degrees. In Leo, for example, it appears with the fullness of its radiance and heat, while elsewhere it is seen otherwise. Now that, by God’s grace, the cloud of mercy has encompassed the whole earth and its inhabitants, and the sun of loving favor shines visibly with the fullness of its splendor and heat, do not occupy yourselves with the whisperings of the devils of self and the embodiments of hatred and envy.

97

و در جمیع حال و احوال حقّ را فاعل مختار و فعّال لما یشآء دانسته و باین کلمهٴ جامعه که اعظم کلمات منزله است ثابت و راسخ بوده لعلّ در دین اللّه و امر او ثابت مانی و این است حقّ صرف و صدق خالص و ما بعد الحقّ الّا الضّلال و هم‌چنانکه ذات مقدّس حقّ دلیل بر او بوده و دون او قاصر و عاجز از عرفان او کما هو حقّه و مستحقّه هم‌چنین آیات منزله از سماء امر او مدّل بر ظهور او است و دون او مفقود صرف و لاشیء محض و غیر مذکور در آنساحت بوده و کفی باللّه شهیدا

Va dar jamīʿ-e ḥāl va aḥvāl Ḥaqq rā fāʿel-e mokhtār va faʿʿālun li-mā yashāʾ dāneste va be-īn kaleme-ye jāmeʿe ke aʿẓam-e kalemāt-e monzale ast thābet va rāsekh būde laʿall dar dīn Allāh va amr-e ū thābet mānī va īn ast ḥaqq-e ṣerf va ṣedq-e khāleṣ wa-mā baʿda al-ḥaqqi illā al-ḍalāl va ham-chenānke dhāt-e moqaddas-e Ḥaqq dalīl bar ū būde va dūn-e ū qāṣer va ʿājez az ʿerfān-e ū kamā huwa ḥaqquhu wa-mustaḥaqquhu ham-chenīn āyāt-e monzale az samā-ye amr-e ū modall bar ẓohūr-e ū ast va dūn-e ū mafqūd-e ṣerf va lā-shayʾ-e maḥḍ va gheyr-e madhkūr dar ān sāḥat būde wa-kafā bi-llāhi shahīdan.

In every condition and circumstance, know God to be a freely choosing Agent who does whatever He wills, and remain firm and unwavering in this all-embracing statement, the greatest of revealed words, so that you may remain steadfast in God’s religion and His Cause. This is pure truth and unalloyed veracity, and what is there beyond truth but error? Just as God’s sanctified Essence is His own proof, and all besides Him falls short and is powerless to recognize Him as He truly deserves, so the verses sent down from the heaven of His Cause bear witness to His Revelation. All besides Him is sheer nonexistence, absolute nothingness, and unmentioned in that court. God is sufficient as a witness.

98

باید در این کلمات جامعهٴ منزله کمال تعقّل و تفکّر مبذول داشت تا از هر بابی از آن ابواب علوم لا نهایه بما لا نهایه بر وجه قلوب طالبین و قاصدین مفتوح شود این مقامی است که احدی جز بجوهر طینت و ساذج فطرت نتواند قدم گذاشت و اگر مرایای قلوب اقلّ من الشّعر بغبار ما سوی بیالاید ابداً تجلّی این نور منیع و امر بدیع در آن مرایا منطبع و مرتسم و متجلّی نشود چه‌قدر ارفع و امنع است اینمقام که جز تقدیس صرف نپذیرد و چه‌قدر عالی و متعالی است که دون تنزیه بحت قبول نفرماید

Bāyad dar īn kalemāt-e jāmeʿe-ye monzale kamāl-e taʿaq qol va tafakkor mabdhūl dāsht tā az har bābī az ān abvāb-e ʿolūm-e lā-nehāye bi-mā lā-nehāye bar vajh-e qolūb-e ṭālebīn va qāṣedīn maftūḥ shavad īn maqāmī ast ke aḥadī joz be-jowhar-e ṭīnat va sādhaj-e feṭrat natavānad qadam godhāsht va agar marāyā-ye qolūb aqall min al-shaʿr be-ghobār-e mā-sevā bīālāyad abadan tajallī-ye īn nūr-e manīʿ va amr-e badīʿ dar ān marāyā monṭabeʿ va mortasem va motajallī nashavad che-qadr arfaʿ va amnaʿ ast īn maqām ke joz taqdīs-e ṣerf napa dhīrad va che-qadr ʿālī va motaʿālī ast ke dūn-e tanzīh-e baḥt qabūl nafarmāyad.

One must devote the fullest measure of understanding and reflection to these all-embracing revealed words, so that from each of them gates of endlessly infinite knowledge may open before the hearts of seekers and aspirants. This is a station into which no one can set foot except with the essence of a pure nature and an unalloyed disposition. If the mirrors of the heart are stained, even by less than a hair’s breadth, with the dust of anything besides Him, the splendor of this exalted Light and wondrous Cause will never be imprinted, reflected, or manifested in those mirrors. How lofty and inaccessible is this station, which admits nothing but pure sanctity, and how high and exalted, accepting nothing short of utter purity!

99

فآه فوق کلّ آه فآه تحت کلّ آه فآه یملأ السّموات من حنین العاشقین فآه یملأ الأرض من ضجیج المشتاقین فآه یجری عن العیون مدامع حمر منیر فآه ثمّ آه ثمّ آه من اوّل الّذی لا اوّل له الی آخر الّذی لن یحصیه کلّ عالم علیم فآه الّذی یظهر فی الوجود ناره و یحدث فی الظّهور حسرته و یحزن کلّ الممکنات و عن ورائه اهل ملأ الصّافین فآه احترقت به الأکباد و تزلزلت عنه البلاد فآه لن یعرفه الّا اللّه العزیز الجمیل

Fa-āhin fawqa kulli āh fa-āhin taḥta kulli āh fa-āhin yamlaʾu al-samāwāti min ḥanīni al-ʿāshiqīn fa-āhin yamlaʾu al-arḍa min ḍajīji al-mushtāqīn fa-āhin yujrī ʿan al-ʿuyūni madāmiʿa ḥumrin munīr fa-āhin thumma āhin thumma āhin min awwali alladhī lā awwala lahu ilā ākhiri alladhī lan yuḥṣiyahu kullu ʿālimin ʿalīm fa-āhi alladhī yaẓharu fī al-wujūdi nāruhu wa-yaḥduthu fī al-ẓuhūri ḥasratuhu wa-yuḥzinu kulla al-mumkināt wa-ʿan warāʾihi ahla malaʾi al-ṣāffīn fa-āhin iḥtaraqat bihi al-akbād wa-tazalzalat ʿanhu al-bilād fa-āhin lan yaʿrifahu illā Allāhu al-ʿAzīzu al-Jamīl.

Ah, a sigh above every sigh! Ah, a sigh beneath every sigh! Ah, a sigh that fills the heavens with the lovers’ lamentation! Ah, a sigh that fills the earth with the cries of those who yearn! Ah, a sigh that makes radiant crimson tears flow from the eyes! Ah, and again ah, and yet again ah, from the beginning that has no beginning to the end that no learned scholar can reckon! Ah, a sigh whose fire appears in existence, whose anguish arises in manifestation, and which grieves all created things and, beyond them, the members of the assembly of those arrayed in ranks! Ah, a sigh by which hearts are burned and lands are shaken! Ah, a sigh that none can know but God, the Almighty, the All-Beautiful!

100

عمّا احتجبوا النّاس عن جمال اللّه و ظهوره و طلعة اللّه و طلوعه و وقع بین یدی هؤلآء بالذّلّة الّتی لن تقاس بذلّة و بالحزن الّذی لن یقابله حزن لا فی الأوّلین و لا فی الآخرین و بذلک بدّل عیش کلّ ذی شعور و تزلزلت ارکان عرش عظیم ولکن النّاس هم فی غفلة و سرور و فی فرح مبین

ʿAmmā iḥtajabū al-nāsu ʿan jamāli Allāhi wa-ẓuhūrihi wa-ṭalʿati Allāhi wa-ṭulūʿihi wa-waqaʿa bayna yaday hāʾulāʾi bi-al-dhillati allatī lan tuqāsa bi-dhillatin wa-bi-al-ḥuzni alladhī lan yuqābilahu ḥuznun lā fī al-awwalīna wa-lā fī al-ākhirīn wa-bi-dhālika buddila ʿayshu kulli dhī shuʿūr wa-tazalzalat arkānu ʿarshin ʿaẓīm wa-lākin al-nāsu hum fī ghaflatin wa-surūrin wa-fī faraḥin mubīn.

For the people have veiled themselves from the Beauty of God and His manifestation, from the Countenance of God and His dawning, and He has fallen into the hands of these people in a humiliation beyond comparison and a sorrow unequaled among either former or later generations. Through this, the life of every conscious being has been altered, and the pillars of a mighty throne have been shaken. Yet the people remain heedless and happy, in manifest delight.

101

کذلک یبطل اللّه عمل الّذینهم غفلوا عن ذکره و کفروا بما عندهم من آیات اللّه المقتدر العزیز القدیر و الرّوح علی اهل الرّوح من هذا البهآء المشرق القدیم

Kadhālika yubṭilu Allāhu ʿamala alladhīna hum ghafalū ʿan dhikrihi wa-kafarū bi-mā ʿindahum min āyāti Allāhi al-Muqtadiri al-ʿAzīzi al-Qadīr. Wa-al-rūḥu ʿalā ahli al-rūḥi min hādhā al-Bahāʾi al-mushriqi al-qadīm.

Thus God brings to nothing the deeds of those who have neglected His remembrance and disbelieved in the verses of God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent, that are in their possession. And may the Spirit rest upon the people of the Spirit from this dawning, ancient Glory.

102

در این ایّام تمحیص کبری خود را حفظ نموده که مبادا از صراط مستقیم بلغزی چه که عنقریب جمیع ناس را مضطرب و متزلزل بل معرض مشاهده خواهی نمود الّا من شآء ربّک و دو سنه قبل در مدینه ورقه نازل شد و جمیع امورات محدثهٴ بعد در آن ثبت شده اگر اقبال بمعرفت الیوم نمائی بآن ورقهٴ مبارکه رجوع کن که شاید نفس خود را از غرقاب فنا نجات داده بمقرّ بقا وارد شوی و از مدینهٴ اسماء و ملکوت آن گذشته بمقام قدس کریم که مقام تقدیس صرف و تنزیه بحت باتّ است درآئی و بغنای حقّ از ذلّت سؤال فارغ شوی چه که سؤال بنفسه دلیل بر تزلزل و عدم استقامت سائل بوده و خواهد بود اگرچه حقّ منیع دوست داشته و میدارد که مسئول واقع شود لأجل اعطای فضل و اعطای فیض ولکن حقّ عرفان را مقام دیگر است و او راجع ببصر و قلب و فؤاد است نه بذکر قلم و مداد کذلک یلقیک قلم السّداد فی هذا الیوم الّذی الیه یرجع حکم المبدأ و المعاد

Dar īn ayyām-e tamḥīṣ-e kubrā khod rā ḥefẓ namūde ke mabādā az ṣerāṭ-e mostaqīm belaghzī, che ke ʿan-qarīb jamīʿ-e nās rā moẓṭareb va motazalzel bal moʿreż moshāhede khwāhī namūd, illā man shāʾa rabbuka. Va do sane qabl dar Madīne varaqe nāzel shod va jamīʿ-e omūrāt-e moḥdathe-ye baʿd dar ān thabt shode. Agar eqbāl be-maʿrefat-e al-yawm namāʾī, be-ān varaqe-ye mobārake rojūʿ kon ke shāyad nafs-e khod rā az gharqāb-e fanā nejāt dāde be-maqarr-e baqā vāred shavī va az madīne-ye asmā va malakūt-e ān godhashte be-maqām-e qods-e karīm ke maqām-e taqdīs-e ṣerf va tanzīh-e baḥt-e bātt ast darāʾī va be-ghenā-ye Ḥaqq az dhellat-e soʾāl fāregh shavī. Che ke soʾāl be-nafse dalīl bar tazalzol va ʿadam-e esteqāmat-e sāʾel būde va khwāhad būd, agarche Ḥaqq-e manīʿ dūst dāshte va mīdārad ke masʾūl vāqeʿ shavad li-ajl-e eʿṭā-ye fażl va eʿṭā-ye feyż. Va-lāken ḥaqq-e ʿerfān rā maqām-e dīgar ast va ū rājeʿ be-baṣar va qalb va foʾād ast na be-dhekr-e qalam va medād. Kadhālika yulqīka qalamu al-sadādi fī hādhā al-yawmi alladhī ilayhi yarjiʿu ḥukmu al-mabdaʾi wa-al-maʿād.

In these days of the supreme testing, guard yourself lest you slip from the straight path, for before long you will see all people agitated and shaken—indeed, turning away—except those whom your Lord wills. Two years ago, a sheet was revealed in the City, and all the events that have since occurred were recorded in it. If you would turn toward recognition today, consult that blessed sheet, so that you may perhaps rescue yourself from the abyss of extinction and enter the abode of everlasting life, pass beyond the city of names and its kingdom, and enter a noble station of holiness, the station of pure sanctity and utter, absolute transcendence. Through the wealth of God, you may then be freed from the abasement of asking. For asking has always been, and will remain, in itself evidence of the questioner’s wavering and lack of steadfastness, although the exalted Truth has loved, and still loves, to be asked, so that He may bestow grace and bounty. Yet true recognition has another station: it pertains to sight, heart, and inmost being, not to what pen and ink set down. Thus does the Pen of rectitude convey to you on this Day, to which the decree of the beginning and the return reverts.

103

و دیگر آنکه سؤال نموده بودی که این عبد چه رتبه و مقام را ادّعا نموده‌اند و ما انا الّا عبد آمنت باللّه و رسله و کتبه و بکلّ ما نزل من عنده و بما نزل علی علیّ بالحقّ و بما نزل حینئذ و بما ینزل فی زمن المستغاث حین الّذی یجدّد فیه کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین هنالک تقوم السّاعة و ینصب المیزان و یرفع الصّراط و یأتی اللّه بأمره ان انتم من العارفین و یشهد بذلک کلّ ما قدّره اللّه فی نفسی ان انتم من الشّاهدین

Va dīgar ānke soʾāl namūde būdī ke īn ʿabd che rotbe va maqām rā eddeʿā namūde-and. Wa-mā anā illā ʿabdun āmantu bi-Allāhi wa-rusulihi wa-kutubihi wa-bi-kulli mā nazala min ʿindihi wa-bi-mā nazala ʿalā ʿAliyyin bi-al-ḥaqqi wa-bi-mā nazala ḥīnaʾidhin wa-bi-mā yanzilu fī zamani al-Mustaghāthi ḥīna alladhī yujaddadu fīhi kullu man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn. Hunālika taqūmu al-sāʿatu wa-yunṣabu al-mīzānu wa-yurfaʿu al-ṣirāṭu wa-yaʾtī Allāhu bi-amrihi in antum mina al-ʿārifīn. Wa-yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu mā qaddarahu Allāhu fī nafsī in antum mina al-shāhidīn.

You also asked what rank and station this servant has claimed. I am only a servant who has believed in God, His Messengers, His Books, and everything sent down from Him; in what was sent down to ʿAlī in truth; in what has been sent down at this time; and in what will be sent down in the time of the Mustaghāth, when everyone in the heavens and the earths will be made anew. Then the Hour will come, the Balance will be set up, the Bridge will be raised, and God will come with His Cause, if you are among those who recognize. Everything God has ordained within Me bears witness to this, if you are among those who bear witness.

104

و سنین معدوده است که هر آن آن خمسین الف سنه میگذرد از تتابع بلایا و ترادف قضایا که آنی تعطیل نشده و علاوه بر این بلایای ظاهریّه فوالّذی ظهر نفس الممکنات بسلطانه و قدرته بلایای باطنیّه که از جمیع عیون و عقول و نفوس مستور بوده در کلّ حین و حان بوده که غیر اللّه بر آن مطّلع نشده و من دون آنچه مذکور شد البتّه شنیده‌اید که اهل بیان چه مقدار مفتریات ظنون افکیّهٴ خود را بر این شجرهٴ مبارکهٴ طیّبهٴ احدیّه نسبت داده و راجع نموده‌اند چنانچه اکتفا بآنچه که اعدا وارد آورده نشده این فئه هم بآنچه قادر و مقتدر بوده‌اند کوتاهی ننموده با اینکه وجود این عبد در جمیع اوقات سبب ارتفاع کلمهٴ طیّبه بوده چنانچه جمیع دانسته و دیده‌اید

Va senīn-e maʿdūde ast ke har ān-e ān khamsīn alf sane mīgodharad az tatāboʿ-e balāyā va tarādof-e qażāyā ke ānī taʿṭīl nashode. Va ʿelāve bar īn balāyā-ye ẓāheriyye, fa-wa-alladhī ẓahara nafsu al-mumkināti bi-sulṭānihi wa-qudratihi, balāyā-ye bāṭeniyye ke az jamīʿ-e ʿoyūn va ʿoqūl va nofūs mastūr būde dar koll-e ḥīn va ḥān būde ke gheyr-e Allāh bar ān moṭṭaleʿ nashode. Va men dūn-e ānche madhkūr shod albatte shenīde-īd ke ahl-e Bayān che meqdār moftariyāt-e ẓonūn-e efkiyye-ye khod rā bar īn shajare-ye mobārake-ye ṭayyebe-ye aḥadiyye nesbat dāde va rājeʿ namūde-and. Chenānche ektefā be-ānche ke aʿdā vāred āvarde nashode, īn feʾe ham be-ānche qāder va moqtader būde-and kūtāhī nanamūde, bā īnke vojūd-e īn ʿabd dar jamīʿ-e awqāt sabab-e ertefāʿ-e kaleme-ye ṭayyebe būde, chenānche jamīʿ dāneste va dīde-īd.

For a number of years, every moment has passed like fifty thousand years, owing to successive afflictions and relentless adversities that have not ceased for an instant. Besides these outward afflictions—by Him through whose sovereignty and power the very being of all contingent things has appeared!—there have at every moment been inward afflictions, hidden from every eye, mind, and soul, of which no one but God has been aware. Apart from what has been mentioned, you have surely heard how many fabrications born of their lying suppositions the people of the Bayān have ascribed and attributed to this blessed, pure Tree of oneness. As though what the enemies had inflicted were not enough, this faction too has held back from nothing within its power and ability, although the existence of this servant has at all times been the cause of the exaltation of the good Word, as all of you have known and seen.

105

دیگر اگر بعضی را افکیّات ظنونیّه حایل شود بین قلوبهم و صدقهم و انکار این فضل منیع نمایند آن امر دیگر است و الی اللّه یرجع الأمور و باطن را هم مثل ظاهر فرض نمائید لو انتم ببصر الرّوح تنظرون و در جمیع این بلایا و محن و رزایای سرّ و علن جز عبودیّت محضه امری و ذکری از این عبد مسجون ظهور ننموده و چنانچه ملاحظه شد که این عبد در مدّت توقّف در مدینة السّلام با جمیع اهل آن ارض و اطراف آن از عالم و دون آن معاشرت نموده و بقدر وسع بل فوق آن در نصرت امر و ارتفاع آن دقیقه‌ئی تغافل نشده چنانچه ارتفاع کلمه بمقامی رسید که جمیع اهل ارض را احاطه نمود

Dīgar agar baʿżī rā efkiyyāt-e ẓonūniyye ḥāʾel shavad bayna qulūbihim wa-ṣidqihim va enkār-e īn fażl-e manīʿ namāyand, ān amr-e dīgar ast, wa-ilā Allāhi yarjiʿu al-umūr. Va bāṭen rā ham methl-e ẓāher farż namāʾīd law antum bi-baṣari al-rūḥi tanẓurūn. Va dar jamīʿ-e īn balāyā va meḥan va razāyā-ye serr va ʿalan joz ʿobūdiyyat-e maḥże amrī va dhekrī az īn ʿabd-e masjūn ẓohūr nanamūde. Va chenānche molāḥeẓe shod ke īn ʿabd dar moddat-e tavaqqof dar Madīnat al-Salām bā jamīʿ-e ahl-e ān arż va aṭrāf-e ān az ʿālem va dūn-e ān moʿāsherat namūde va be-qadr-e vosʿ bal fawq-e ān dar noṣrat-e Amr va ertefāʿ-e ān daqīqe-ī taghāfol nashode, chenānche ertefāʿ-e kaleme be-maqāmī resīd ke jamīʿ-e ahl-e arż rā eḥāṭe namūd.

If, however, conjectural falsehoods should come between some people’s hearts and their sincerity, and they should deny this exalted grace, that is another matter; to God all affairs return. Consider the inward to be like the outward as well, if you look with the eye of the spirit. Amid all these afflictions, trials, and calamities, hidden and manifest, nothing but pure servitude has appeared in any act or utterance of this imprisoned servant. As has been observed, throughout His stay in the City of Peace this servant associated with all the people of that land and its surroundings, learned and otherwise. To the extent of His ability—indeed, beyond it—not a moment was neglected in aiding and exalting the Cause, until the exaltation of the Word reached such a degree that it encompassed all the people of the earth.

106

و ابداً با اعدای الهی مداهنه ننموده بکمال جدّ و اجتهاد در ذکر کلمهٴ ذکریّه سعی بلیغ و جهد منیع مبذول شده و بالأخره امر منجرّ بحرکت از مدینه شد آن هم بر هر ذی بصری معلوم شده که بچه نحو در این خروج و هجرت اعتزاز این امر و علوّ آن ظاهر شده تا آنکه باین مقرّ مسجون و محبوس گشته‌ایم و نشکر اللّه فی کلّ ذلک و نحمده و نذکره و نصبر علی قضایاه و انّه موفی اجور الصّابرین و الحمد للّه علی کلّ ذلک و لا ملجأ الّا به و لا مستعان الّا هو و انّه لهو المقتدر العزیز الرّحیم

Va abadan bā aʿdā-ye elāhī modāhene nanamūde, be-kamāl-e jedd va ejtehād dar dhekr-e kaleme-ye dhekriyye saʿy-e balīgh va jahd-e manīʿ mabdhūl shode. Va be-al-ākhere amr monjarr be-ḥarakat az Madīne shod. Ān ham bar har dhī-baṣarī maʿlūm shode ke be-che naḥv dar īn khorūj va hejrat eʿtezāz-e īn Amr va ʿolovv-e ān ẓāher shode, tā ānke be-īn maqarr masjūn va maḥbūs gashte-īm. Wa-nashkuru Allāha fī kulli dhālika wa-naḥmaduhu wa-nadhkuruhu wa-naṣbiru ʿalā qaḍāyāhu wa-innahu muwaffī ujūri al-ṣābirīn. Wa-al-ḥamdu li-Allāhi ʿalā kulli dhālika wa-lā maljaʾa illā bihi wa-lā mustaʿāna illā huwa wa-innahu la-huwa al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAzīzu al-Raḥīm.

Never was any compromise made with the enemies of God. With the utmost earnestness and diligence, strenuous effort and resolute exertion were devoted to proclaiming the Word of remembrance. In the end, matters led to departure from the City. Every discerning person has also come to know how the might and exaltation of this Cause were manifested in that departure and migration, until We became imprisoned and confined in this place. In all this We thank God, praise Him, remember Him, and bear patiently with His decrees. He indeed pays in full the rewards of the patient. Praise be to God for all this. There is no refuge except in Him and no one whose help can be sought but Him. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Merciful.

107

بلی در جمیع این سنین ماضیه بحمد اللّه ابحر معانی و انوار ربّانی در دل متموّج و مستضیء بوده چنانچه من غیر اراده رشحات آن بر ممکنات مبذول میشد و بقسمی عنایت ربّ العزّة احاطه فرموده که احصا و تحدید آن از امکان و اهل آن خارج و اگر از این عبد در بیان این مراتب در الواح منزله ذکری رفته لأجل اتّباع این کلمهٴ منیعه بوده که میفرماید و امّا بنعمة ربّک فحدّث ولکن آنجناب نظر باصل امر داشته که بدون خود هرگز مشتبه نشده و نخواهد شد

Balī dar jamīʿ-e īn senīn-e māżiye be-ḥamd-e Allāh abḥor-e maʿānī va anvār-e rabbānī dar del motamavvej va mostażīʾ būde, chenānche men gheyr-e erāde rashaḥāt-e ān bar momkenāt mabdhūl mīshod. Va be-qesmī ʿenāyat-e Rabb al-ʿEzzat eḥāṭe farmūde ke eḥṣā va taḥdīd-e ān az emkān va ahl-e ān khārej. Va agar az īn ʿabd dar bayān-e īn marāteb dar alvāḥ-e monzale dhekrī rafte, li-ajl-e ettebāʿ-e īn kaleme-ye manīʿe būde ke mīfarmāyad: wa-ammā bi-niʿmati rabbika fa-ḥaddith. Va-lāken ān-jenāb naẓar be-aṣl-e amr dāshte ke be-dūn-e khod harg ez moshtabeh nashode va nakhwāhad shod.

Indeed, throughout all these past years, praise be to God, oceans of meaning have surged and divine lights have shone within the heart, so that, without any act of will, their sprinklings were bestowed upon contingent beings. The favor of the Lord of might has so encompassed Us that to number or delimit it is beyond the contingent world and its inhabitants. If this servant has made any mention of these degrees in the revealed Tablets, it has been in obedience to this exalted utterance: “As for the bounty of your Lord, proclaim it.” You, however, should look to the essence of the matter, which has never been, and will never be, confused with anything other than itself.

108

و اگر حقّ منیع را نتوانی بنفس او ادراک نمائی و مستبصر شوی و دون آن بکلمات منزله از سماء قدس احدیّه ناظر باشی رجوع بکتب منزله از سماء مشیّت نما که در اکثر آن ذکر این کلمهٴ جامعهٴ مستوره تصریحاً و تلویحاً مشاهده خواهی نمود در توقیع عظیم و دون آن ملاحظه نما و هم‌چنین اکثر از آیات قیّوم اسماء مشعر بر قیّومیّت این سدرهٴ مرتفعهٴ منیعه بوده قسم بخدا که شرم دارم از ذکر این بیانات چه که ایّامی از ظهور آن شمس مشرقهٴ احدیّه نگذشته و کلّ کیفیّت ظهور را بعین خود مشاهده نموده‌اند و مع‌ذلک جمیع محتجب گشته‌اند

Va agar Ḥaqq-e manīʿ rā natavānī be-nafs-e ū edrāk namāʾī va mostabṣer shavī va dūn-e ān be-kalemāt-e monzale az samā-ye qods-e aḥadiyye nāẓer bāshī, rojūʿ be-kotob-e monzale az samā-ye mashiyyat namā ke dar akthar-e ān dhekr-e īn kaleme-ye jāmeʿe-ye mastūre taṣrīḥan va talvīḥan moshāhede khwāhī namūd. Dar Tawqīʿ-e ʿAẓīm va dūn-e ān molāḥeẓe namā. Va ham-chenīn akthar az āyāt-e Qayyūm-e Asmā moshʿer bar qayyūmiyyat-e īn sedre-ye mortafeʿe-ye manīʿe būde. Qasam be-Khodā ke sharm dāram az dhekr-e īn bayānāt, che ke ayyāmī az ẓohūr-e ān shams-e moshreqe-ye aḥadiyye nagodhashte va koll keyfiyyat-e ẓohūr rā be-ʿayn-e khod moshāhede namūde-and va maʿa-dhālek jamīʿ moḥtajeb gashte-and.

If you cannot apprehend the exalted Truth through His own Self and gain insight, but look instead to the words sent down from the heaven of the holiness of oneness, turn to the Books sent down from the heaven of the divine Will. In most of them you will find mention, both explicit and implicit, of this all-embracing, concealed Word. Examine the Great Epistle and other writings. Likewise, most of the verses of the Qayyūm al-Asmāʾ indicate the all-sustaining sovereignty of this lofty, exalted Tree. I swear by God that I am ashamed to mention these statements, for only a few days have passed since the appearance of that dawning Sun of oneness, and all have witnessed with their own eyes the manner of that appearance. Yet all have become veiled.

109

و کدام ذکر و بیان اظهر از نفس خود ظهور است تا بآن استدلال شود باری حال ملاحظه نما که چه مقدار ستر و تعویق این امر مشعر و مدلّ بر علوّ این ظهور است که گویا تعویق آن را سببی جز امتحان و افتتان کلّ من فی السّموات و الأرض نبوده و هم‌چنین میفرماید انتم فی التّسع بلقآء اللّه ترزقون اگرچه بعضی این ظهور قدس صمدانی و طلوع نور سبحانی را اراده نموده‌اند که بدون سدرهٴ خود راجع نمایند و بجدّ تمام در تحریف این کلمهٴ جامعه سعی نمایند ولکن الأمر بید اللّه یهدی من یشآء الی صراط مستقیم

Va kodām dhekr va bayān aẓhar az nafs-e khod-e ẓohūr ast tā be-ān estedlāl shavad? Bārī ḥāl molāḥeẓe namā ke che meqdār satr va taʿvīq-e īn Amr moshʿer va modell bar ʿolovv-e īn ẓohūr ast, ke gūyā taʿvīq-e ān rā sababī joz emteḥān va eftetān-e kulli man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍ nabūde. Va ham-chenīn mīfarmāyad: antum fī al-tisʿi bi-liqāʾi Allāhi turzaqūn. Agarche baʿżī īn ẓohūr-e qods-e ṣamadānī va ṭolūʿ-e nūr-e sobḥānī rā erāde namūde-and ke be-dūn-e sedre-ye khod rājeʿ namāyand va be-jedd-e tamām dar taḥrīf-e īn kaleme-ye jāmeʿe saʿy namāyand, va-lāken al-amru bi-yadi Allāhi yahdī man yashāʾu ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm.

What mention or statement is more manifest than the Revelation itself, that it might be used as proof of it? Consider now how greatly the concealment and delay of this Cause indicate and attest the exaltation of this Revelation, as though its delay had no purpose other than to test and try everyone in the heavens and on earth. He likewise says: “In the year nine you will be granted the meeting with God.” Although some have sought to refer this manifestation of eternal holiness and this dawning of divine light to something other than His own Tree, and strive with all earnestness to distort this all-embracing utterance, the matter is in God’s hands: He guides whomever He wills to a straight path.

110

ای اهل بیان کمال سعی مبذول داشته که مثل اهل فرقان نباشید که جمیع صفات و اسماء را از منتهی مقام عزّ جبروت الی ادنی رتبهٴ ناسوت بطلعات غیب راجع نموده‌اند و از مطالع احدیّه و مظاهر قدمیّه که بالفعل موجودند غافل بوده و خواهند بود

Ey ahl-e Bayān, kamāl-e saʿy mabdhūl dāshte ke methl-e ahl-e Forqān nabāshīd ke jamīʿ-e ṣefāt va asmā rā az montahā maqām-e ʿezz-e jabarūt ilā adnā rotbe-ye nāsūt be-ṭalaʿāt-e gheyb rājeʿ namūde-and va az maṭāleʿ-e aḥadiyye va maẓāher-e qadamiyye ke be-al-feʿl mawjūdand ghāfel būde va khwāhand būd.

People of the Bayān! Make every effort not to be like the people of the Qurʾān, who have referred all attributes and names, from the highest station of the glory of dominion to the lowest degree of the human realm, to unseen countenances, while remaining heedless of the Dawning-Places of oneness and Manifestations of eternity who actually exist.

111

حال ای عباد ببصر عدل و انصاف مشاهده نمائید که این عبد قسم بظهور من یظهره اللّه که اگر در مدّت اقامت در دارالسّلام اگر یومی و یا لیلی بر حسب ظاهر گمان حیات مینمودم چه که اعدا از یمین و یسار و جنوب و شمال بکمال جدّ در صدد بوده‌اند چنانچه جمیع عباد ساکنهٴ آن محلّ مطّلعند تا آنکه تقدیر ربّانی بر تزویر شیطانی فایق آمد و سلطان علّیّین بر صور سجّین غلبه نمود و با این علوّ و اشتهار با جمعی از مهاجران هجرت نموده و ارتفاع این اسم و شهرت و ظهور آن من غیر اراده واقع شده

Ḥāl ey ʿebād, be-baṣar-e ʿadl va enṣāf moshāhede namāʾīd ke īn ʿabd, qasam be-ẓohūr-e Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh, ke agar dar moddat-e eqāmat dar Dār al-Salām agar yawmī va yā laylī bar ḥasab-e ẓāher gomān-e ḥayāt mīnamūdam, che ke aʿdā az yamīn va yasār va jonūb va shamāl be-kamāl-e jedd dar ṣadad būde-and, chenānche jamīʿ-e ʿebād-e sākene-ye ān maḥall moṭṭaleʿand. Tā ānke taqdīr-e rabbānī bar tazvīr-e sheyṭānī fāʾeq āmad va solṭān-e ʿelliyyīn bar ṣovar-e sejjīn ghalabe namūd va bā īn ʿolovv va eshtehār bā jamʿī az mohājerān hejrat namūde va ertefāʿ-e īn esm va shohrat va ẓohūr-e ān men gheyr-e erāde vāqeʿ shode.

Now, servants, look with the eye of justice and fairness: I swear by the Revelation of Him whom God will make manifest that, throughout this servant’s residence in the Abode of Peace, not for a day or a night did outward circumstances give Me reason to expect to remain alive. For enemies on the right and left, to the south and north, were intent upon their purpose with the utmost determination, as all the inhabitants of that place know. At last divine destiny prevailed over satanic deception, and the sovereignty of the heights overcame the forms of the depths. With such exaltation and renown, this servant departed with a company of emigrants. The exaltation of this Name, its fame, and its manifestation came about without any act of will.

112

دیگر چه ذکر نمایم که چه بر این عبد گذشته و وارد شده فواللّه لن یقدر ان یسمعه ذی حبّ و لا ذی قلب و لا ذی نظر و لا ذی شعور

Dīgar che dhekr namāyam ke che bar īn ʿabd godhashte va vāred shode? Fa-wa-Allāhi lan yaqdira an yasmaʿahu dhī ḥubbin wa-lā dhī qalbin wa-lā dhī naẓarin wa-lā dhī shuʿūr.

What more can I say of what this servant has endured and what has befallen Him? By God, no one possessed of love, a heart, vision, or awareness could bear to hear it.

113

باری لم‌یزل اسرار الهیّه در کنوز عصمتیّه مستور بوده و لایزال در حجبات حفظیّه مصون و محفوظ خواهد بود و اگر جبل انفس عباد مندکّ نمیشد رمزی از اسرار محجّبهٴ مقنّعهٴ مستره ذکر مینمودم ولکن اللّه مظهر ما یشآء و ما انا بمظهر ما هو المستور و بر همهٴ شما و اهل ارض معلوم بوده که چه مقدار عبودیّت و خضوع از این عبد بجمیع ادلّا و احبّا از اوّل ظهور شمس حقیقت الی الیوم ظاهر شده و مع‌ذلک چه نسبتهای کذبه باین عبد راجع و احدی در صدد رفع آن برنیامده الی اللّه فوّضت امری و علیه توکّلت و علیه فلیتوکّلنّ عباده المنقطعین

Bārī lam-yazal asrār-e elāhiyye dar konūz-e ʿeṣmatiyye mastūr būde va lā-yazāl dar ḥojobāt-e ḥefẓiyye maṣūn va maḥfūẓ khwāhad būd. Va agar jabal-e anfos-e ʿebād mondakk namīshod ramzī az asrār-e moḥajjabe-ye moqannaʿe-ye mostatar dhekr mīnamūdam, wa-lākin Allāhu muẓhiru mā yashāʾu wa-mā anā bi-muẓhiri mā huwa al-mastūr. Va bar hame-ye shomā va ahl-e arż maʿlūm būde ke che meqdār ʿobūdiyyat va khożūʿ az īn ʿabd be-jamīʿ-e adellā va aḥebbā az avval-e ẓohūr-e Shams-e Ḥaqīqat ilā al-yawm ẓāher shode. Va maʿa-dhālek che nesbat-hā-ye kadhebe be-īn ʿabd rājeʿ va aḥadī dar ṣadad-e rafʿ-e ān barnayāmade. Ilā Allāhi fawwaḍtu amrī wa-ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ʿalayhi fa-l-yatawakkalanna ʿibāduhu al-munqaṭiʿīn.

In any case, the divine mysteries have always been concealed in the treasuries of protection and will forever remain secure and guarded within sheltering veils. Were the mountain of the servants’ souls not to be crushed, I would mention a hint of the veiled, shrouded, hidden mysteries. But God reveals whatever He wills, and I will not reveal what is concealed. All of you, and the people of the earth, have known how much servitude and humility this servant has shown toward all the guides and loved ones, from the first appearance of the Sun of Truth until today. Yet how many false accusations have been directed against this servant, and no one has sought to dispel them. To God I have committed My affair, and in Him I have placed My trust. In Him let His detached servants place their trust.

114

و دیگر سؤال شده بود که چگونه میشود کلمات عالین بسجّین تبدیل شوند و حروف اثبات از مظاهر نفی محسوب شود این معلوم آنجناب بوده که آن شمس فیض ربّانی و بحر فضل سبحانی اشراق فرمود بر جمیع مرایای موجودات در بعضی که مقابله نموده‌اند بقرصه منطبع میشود و بر دون آن همان روشنی شعاع ظاهر اینست که آن شمس قدم بعد از انطباع او در صور مرایا آنچه وصف نماید مرایا را باوصاف غیر متناهیه خود را وصف نموده چه که انوار وجه خود را در مرایا مشاهده مینماید و جمیع این اوصاف منیعه فی‌الحقیقه بخود او راجع است و این فضل در مرایا موجود است بالتّقابل الیها و بعد از انحراف فانی و معدوم خواهند بود

Va dīgar suʾāl shode būd ke chegūne mīshavad kalimāt-i ʿālīn bi-Sijjīn tabdīl shavand va ḥurūf-i ithbāt az maẓāhir-i nafy maḥsūb shavad. Īn maʿlūm-i ān janāb būde ke ān shams-i fayḍ-i rabbānī va baḥr-i faḍl-i subḥānī ishrāq farmūd bar jamīʿ-i marāyā-yi mawjūdāt. Dar baʿḍī ke muqābele namūde-and bi-qurṣihi munṭabiʿ mīshavad va bar dūn-i ān hamān rawshanī-yi shuʿāʿ ẓāhir. Īnast ke ān shams-i qidam baʿd az inṭibāʿ-i ū dar ṣuvar-i marāyā ānche vaṣf namāyad marāyā rā bi-awṣāf-i ghayr-i mutanāhiye khwad rā vaṣf namūde, che ke anvār-i vajh-i khwad rā dar marāyā mushāhede mīnamāyad va jamīʿ-i īn awṣāf-i manīʿe fī’l-ḥaqīqe bi-khwad-i ū rājiʿ ast va īn faḍl dar marāyā mawjūd ast bi’l-taqābul ilayhā va baʿd az inḥirāf fānī va maʿdūm khwāhand būd.

Another question was asked: how can the words of the exalted be changed into Sijjin, and the letters of affirmation be counted among the manifestations of negation? You know that the Sun of divine grace and the Ocean of heavenly bounty shone upon all the mirrors of existence. In some that have turned to face it, its disk is imprinted, while upon the others only the brightness of its rays appears. Thus, after that Sun of eternity has been imprinted in the forms of the mirrors, whatever description it gives of the mirrors, with attributes beyond number, is a description of itself, for it beholds the lights of its own face in the mirrors. All these exalted attributes in reality refer to it alone. This bounty exists in the mirrors through their facing it; once they turn away, these attributes will vanish and cease to exist.

115

حال نظر را پاک نما از غبار ما سوی تا عارف بر شمسی شوی که اگر جمیع مرایای موجودات اقلّ من آن باو مقابل شوند در جمیع انوار حقیقت و آثار عزّ احدیّت لم‌یزل و لایزال منطبع و مرتسم شود و من دون ذلک یمحو اللّه ما یشآء و یثبت و عنده امّ الکتاب فاعل مختار مختار است محو میفرماید بعد از اثبات و کذلک بالعکس و در این مقام است که میفرماید لا تفرحوا بما اتاکم و لا تیأسوا عمّا فاتکم و اینمقام نقطهٴ عدل است که جمیع ما سوی خائف و راجی بوده و خواهند بود هر ذی علوّی خائف است از محو و هر ذی دنوّی راجی بمقام اثبات فوالّذی نفس حسین بیده که اگر شرح اینمقام را بما قدّر فیه ذکر نمایم اکثر از ناس را متزلزل بینی قوله عزّ ذکره را متذکّر شو لو شئنا لنذهبنّ ما اوحینا الیک فوعمری لو القی علیک ازید من ذلک لیرتاب المبطلون

Ḥāl naẓar rā pāk namā az ghubār-i mā sivā tā ʿārif bar shamsī shavī ke agar jamīʿ-i marāyā-yi mawjūdāt aqall-i min ān bi-ū muqābil shavand dar jamīʿ anvār-i ḥaqīqat va āthār-i ʿizz-i aḥadiyyat-i lam-yazal va lā-yazāl munṭabiʿ va murtasim shavad va min dūni dhālika yamḥū Allāhu mā yashāʾu wa-yuthbitu wa-ʿindahu ummu’l-kitāb. Fāʿil-i mukhtār mukhtār ast. Maḥv mīfarmāyad baʿd az ithbāt va kadhālika bi’l-ʿaks va dar īn maqām ast ke mīfarmāyad lā tafraḥū bi-mā ātākum wa-lā tayʾasū ʿammā fātakum va īn maqām nuqṭe-yi ʿadl ast ke jamīʿ-i mā sivā khāʾif va rājī būde va khwāhand būd. Har dhī ʿuluvvī khāʾif ast az maḥv va har dhī dunuvvī rājī bi-maqām-i ithbāt. Fa-wa’lladhī nafsu Ḥusaynin bi-yadihi ke agar sharḥ-i īn maqām rā bi-mā quddira fīhi dhikr namāyam akthar az nās rā mutazalzil bīnī. Qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu rā mutadhakkir shaw: law shiʾnā la-nadhhabanna mā awḥaynā ilayka. Fa-wa-ʿamrī law ulqiya ʿalayka azyadu min dhālika la-yartābu’l-mubṭilūn.

Now cleanse your vision of the dust of all else, so that you may recognize a Sun such that, were all the mirrors of existence to face it for the briefest instant, the lights of truth and the signs of the glory of eternal and everlasting unity would be imprinted and reflected in them all. Otherwise, “God effaces whatever He wills and establishes whatever He wills, and with Him is the Mother Book.” The freely choosing Agent is free to choose. He effaces after establishing, and likewise the reverse. It is in this connection that He says, “Do not rejoice in what has come to you, nor despair over what has escaped you.” This station is the point of justice, at which all else has ever stood, and will ever stand, in fear and hope. Everyone who occupies a lofty position fears effacement, and everyone in a lowly position hopes for the station of affirmation. By Him in whose hand is the soul of Husayn! Were I to explain this station according to what has been ordained within it, you would see most people shaken. Recall His words—exalted be His mention—“If We willed, We would surely take away what We have revealed to you.” By My life! Were more than this imparted to you, those who follow falsehood would surely be filled with doubt.

116

دیگر در اینمقام بیش از این دوست نمیدارم که ذکر نمایم چه که ناس در وهم صرف مستغرقند و دیگر از بعضی امور واقعه که سؤال نمودی در غیبت این عبد واقع شده و حسنه و سیّئهٴ آن بعاملین و فاعلین راجع است باری جمیع امور واضح و لایح است اگر حجبات وهمیّهٴ ناس خرق شود و ببصر خود در امر اللّه تفرّس نمایند جمیع اسرار را مشهود مشاهده نمایند انشآءاللّه امیدواریم که فضلی از منبع جود و افضال ربّ العزّة و العظمة ظاهر شود و جمیع محتجبین را از حجبات ظلمت بسرادقات وحدت کشاند واللّه معطی ما یشآء و انّه لهو الفضّال القدیم و الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Dīgar dar īn maqām bīsh az īn dūst namīdāram ke dhikr namāyam che ke nās dar vahm-i ṣirf mustaghriqand va dīgar az baʿḍī umūr-i vāqiʿe ke suʾāl namūdī dar ghaybat-i īn ʿabd vāqiʿ shode va ḥasane va sayyiʾe-yi ān bi-ʿāmilīn va fāʿilīn rājiʿ ast. Bārī jamīʿ-i umūr vāḍiḥ va lāyiḥ ast agar ḥujubāt-i vahmiyye-yi nās kharq shavad va bi-baṣar-i khwad dar amr-i Allāh tafarrus namāyand jamīʿ-i asrār rā mashhūd mushāhede namāyand. In shāʾ Allāh umīdvārīm ke faḍlī az manbaʿ-i jūd va ifḍāl-i Rabb-i ʿIzzat va ʿAẓamat ẓāhir shavad va jamīʿ-i muḥtajibīn rā az ḥujubāt-i ẓulmat bi-surādiqāt-i vaḥdat kashānad. Wa-Allāhu muʿṭī mā yashāʾu wa-innahu la-huwa’l-Faḍḍālu’l-Qadīm. Wa’l-ḥamdu li’llāhi Rabbi’l-ʿālamīn.

I do not wish to say anything further on this subject, for people are immersed in sheer illusion. As for some of the events about which you asked, they occurred in this servant’s absence, and their good and evil rest with those who carried them out. In any case, everything is clear and manifest. If the veils of people’s illusions were torn apart and they examined the Cause of God with their own eyes, they would plainly behold all its mysteries. God willing, We hope that a bounty may appear from the source of the generosity and grace of the Lord of might and grandeur, drawing all who are veiled from the veils of darkness into the pavilions of unity. God bestows whatever He wills, and He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Ancient. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

117

و دیگر وصیّت این عبد جمیع را آنکه آنی غفلت ننموده مراقب امر اللّه باشند و نهایت جدّ و اجتهاد را در حفظ و صیانت آن مرعی داشته که این است کلّ خیر و اصل آن لأجل آنکه اوّل امر معرفة اللّه بوده و خواهد بود و کلّ آنچه مسموع و مشهود شده طایف حول این امر است چه که جمیع از او ظاهر و باو راجع و بعد از معرفت ذات احدیّه اتّباع امر و اجرای حدود او از اعظم امور بوده و لم‌یزل و لایزال نفحات ذکریّه از مدینهٴ امریّه در هبوب بوده و آثار الهی از این نفحهٴ قدس صمدانی بین بریّه قائم خواهد بود باری انشآءاللّه بقلب صافی خالص توجّه بمبدأ خود در کلّ اوقات و احیان نموده و از ما سوی اللّه منقطع شده که شاید در این ایّام مظلمه از معرفت آن شمس احدیّه محجوب نمانند

Va dīgar vaṣiyyat-i īn ʿabd jamīʿ rā ānke ānī ghaflat nanamūde murāqib-i amr-i Allāh bāshand va nihāyat-i jidd va ijtihād rā dar ḥifẓ va ṣiyānat-i ān marʿī dāshte ke īn ast kull-i khayr va aṣl-i ān li-ajl-i ānke avval-i amr maʿrifat-i Allāh būde va khwāhad būd va kull-i ānche masmūʿ va mashhūd shode ṭāyif-i ḥawl-i īn amr ast che ke jamīʿ az ū ẓāhir va bi-ū rājiʿ va baʿd az maʿrifat-i dhāt-i aḥadiyye ittibāʿ-i amr va ijrā-yi ḥudūd-i ū az aʿẓam-i umūr būde va lam-yazal va lā-yazāl nafaḥāt-i dhikriyye az madīne-yi amriyye dar hubūb būde va āthār-i ilāhī az īn nafḥe-yi quds-i ṣamadānī bayn-i bariyye qāʾim khwāhad būd. Bārī in shāʾ Allāh bi-qalb-i ṣāfī-yi khāliṣ tavajjuh bi-mabdaʾ-i khwad dar kull-i awqāt va aḥyān namūde va az mā siva’llāh munqaṭiʿ shode ke shāyad dar īn ayyām-i muẓlime az maʿrifat-i ān shams-i aḥadiyye maḥjūb namānand.

Further, this servant counsels everyone not to be heedless for a moment, but to watch over the Cause of God and exercise the utmost diligence and effort in preserving and protecting it, for this is the whole of goodness and its root. The first concern has been, and will ever be, the recognition of God, and everything that has been heard and witnessed revolves around this matter, for everything proceeds from Him and returns to Him. After recognition of the one divine Essence, following His command and enforcing His laws are among the greatest concerns. The breezes of remembrance have always blown, and will forever blow, from the city of His Cause, and through this holy, eternal breath the signs of God will remain established among His creatures. God willing, may all turn toward their Source with pure and sincere hearts at every moment and at all times, detaching themselves from everything but God, so that in these darkened days they may not remain veiled from recognizing that Sun of oneness.

118

و این عبد از ربّ العزّة مسئلت مینماید که بصر و سمعی مقدّس از تحدید و تقلید بجمیع عنایت فرماید و اللّه واهب ما یشآء و انّه لهو الوهّاب العلیم الکریم و اختم نغمات الرّوح بذکر اللّه الأعظم الأکبر العظیم لیکون ختامها مسک الا انّ بذلک تستجذب ارواح المخلصین فی کلّ حین و الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Va īn ʿabd az Rabb-i ʿIzzat masʾalat mīnamāyad ke baṣar va samʿī muqaddas az taḥdīd va taqlīd bi-jamīʿ ʿināyat farmāyad. Wa-Allāhu wāhibu mā yashāʾu wa-innahu la-huwa’l-Wahhābu’l-ʿAlīmu’l-Karīm. Wa-akhtimu naghamāti’l-rūḥi bi-dhikri Allāhi’l-Aʿẓami’l-Akbari’l-ʿAẓīm li-yakūna khitāmuhā misk. Alā inna bi-dhālika tustajdhabu arwāḥu’l-mukhliṣīna fī kulli ḥīn. Wa’l-ḥamdu li’llāhi Rabbi’l-ʿālamīn.

This servant asks the Lord of might to bestow on everyone sight and hearing sanctified from limitation and imitation. God bestows whatever He wills, and He is indeed the Ever-Bestowing, the All-Knowing, the Generous. I conclude the melodies of the Spirit with the remembrance of God, the Most Great, the Supreme, the Mighty, so that their close may be musk. Truly, through this the souls of the sincere are drawn at every moment. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

BH00010 (Unnamed)
Javahiru’l-Asrar (Gems of Divine Mysteries)
